content: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE TEAM The Office of the CTPO accelerates all of Product & Technology: faster, clearer decisions, more output per person, and teams empowered to innovate. We sit at the center of how P&T plans, prioritizes and stays aligned with the rest of Trustly, and we increasingly shape how the whole company plans. ABOUT THE ROLE Working closely with the Chief of Staff, you'll run the machinery behind how P&T plans, measures progress and makes decisions stick. You'll work frequently with the CTPO, the executive team and the leaders who run our largest businesses, and you'll help teams across the company plan and execute faster. This role is for someone who can't stand wasted effort. You'd rather ship a one-page answer on Tuesday than a perfect model next month. You build the simplest process that works, automate it, and move on to the next problem. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Run the mechanics of annual planning and execution tracking for P&T, and help make sure every organization across the company is plugged into the same framework. - Run the monthly P&T business review end to end: one trusted set of numbers, risks flagged early, and decisions tracked to done.
